name: mail-muncher
description: mail-muncher — an email client for AI agents: filtered, read-only mail from any IMAP server or Gmail, delivered to disk and served over MCP.

plugins.name: mail-muncher
plugins.description: Give an agent its own read-only mailbox, from any IMAP server (Fastmail, iCloud, Gmail, Proton Bridge, self-hosted) or from the Gmail API. Archives the messages matching ordered filter rules to disk as byte-faithful .eml plus markdown with YAML frontmatter, re-reading an externally-owned domain list every cycle so an agent subscribes to mail by editing a text file. Bundles a stdio MCP server exposing list_messages, read_message, search_messages, list_rules and sync.
